visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen comparison of a woman's face. The left side shows skin with significant brown pigmentation and sun spots, while the right side displays clear, smooth, and bright skin after treatment. (2) A female doctor wearing glasses and a professional white lab coat is seated in a well-lit clinical office. She speaks directly to the camera with mild facial expressions, occasionally gesturing with her hands. The background contains a desk, a monitor, and professional certificates on the wall. (3) Close-up shots show a patient's skin undergoing laser treatment. Protective eye shields are placed on the patient. Various medical laser handpieces, including ones labeled '560', are applied to the skin, emitting red light pulses. (4) The scene returns to the doctor in the office, who continues her explanation with focused eye contact. (5) The final phase is a static graphic overlay showing the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone numbers, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an upbeat, clean acoustic guitar melody. A female voice speaks with a clear, authoritative yet friendly tone, articulating Traditional Chinese words professionally. (2) A subtle synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual transition. The speaker continues her explanation with a steady pace and moderate pitch. (3) A brief interaction occurs where a second female voice provides a short response with lower intensity. The main speaker resumes, her voice well-balanced over the melodic BGM. (4) Towards the end, the background music swells slightly in brightness, incorporating soft piano accents. The vocal delivery becomes more encouraging. (5) The audio concludes with the music fading out alongside a soft digital chime effect as the information screen appears.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Result Preview -> Consultant Dialogue -> Procedural Evidence -> Final Conclusion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote DRX Dermatology Clinic by showcasing the dramatic results of spot-removal and skin-brightening treatments. It uses a professional consultation format to build trust and demonstrate medical expertise, followed by visual proof of the laser procedure and contact information to drive bookings.
